kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرتعد (form VIII)
# أَرْتَعِدُ (ʔartaʕidu) /ʔar.ta.ʕi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
# أَرْتَعِدَ (ʔartaʕida) /ʔar.ta.ʕi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
# أَرْتَعِدْ (ʔartaʕid) /ʔar.ta.ʕid/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
